summary: Added deploy-root-guard.sh, sourced into all 24 core scripts right after their root computation; source-store runs now exit 1 with no stray artifacts, deploy-tree runs unaffected. De-anchored .gitignore's .agent-logs entry. Verified live both ways (guard fires, guard silent, no stray dirs), not by diff-reading alone. Rule F doc-lint now correctly reports 24 drift failures (expected, unresolvable headlessly) until the user runs <leader>al Sync all.
files_modified: 23 uniform core scripts + check-extension-docs.sh (one guard line each)
decisions_made: Single ~25-line shared guard helper instead of 24 inline blocks (~37 vs ~120 net new lines)
check-extension-docs.sh guard gated on REPO_ROOT being unset, preserving its deliberate override
